verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing docs and community evidence confirm subscription billing with usage-based pricing (Billing Meters API) and community corroboration of per-user/per-usage/per-tier models, but the evidence never explicitly documents graduated, volume-tiered, hybrid subscription+usage, credits, commitment, or overage pricing constructs, nor confirms a no-code path for usage-based setups (docs call the meter API a 'lower-level primitive').  missing for 10: explicit tiered/volume/graduated pricing docs, credits/commitment/overage billing evidence, and confirmation that hybrid models can be configured without custom code.
